verdict.rationale: Portkey's docs describe it as a unified interface to 250+ models. One Portkey API key reaches multiple providers through a single OpenAI-compatible base URL, and models are addressed with a consistent `@provider-slug/model-name` syntax. That syntax covers AWS, Azure, Vertex AI and on-prem backends like vLLM and Ollama. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API stays consistent across providers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call many model providers through one consistent API

citations.quote: It serves as a unified interface for interacting with over 250 AI models
one Portkey API key gives you access to multiple providers and models
Access AWS, Azure, Vertex AI, and on-prem solutions like Nvidia Triton, vLLM, and Ollama through a single, unified Portkey API.
Add a provider, then use `@provider-slug/model-name` in your code.
The base URL for all REST API requests is `https://api.portkey.ai/v1`
